scope: Actual read-only receiving-edge queue/worker logs and sample-boundary fades. No simulation or waveform is generated here.
notes: waiting counts valid queued descriptors and excludes running.
running is scheduler group preparation; matrix_merge_busy is actual manager state17, a distinct background calculation.
Waiting masks are counted only under their corresponding q0/q1 valid bit. Stale unselected payloads are not tasks.
Queue occupancy proves mechanism/actual overlap; it does not by itself prove better filter quality than another method.
